Summary: Delivery Performance & Customer Experience Analytics
Description: Build one trusted view of orders, deliveries, reviews and revenue; quantify the impact of late delivery; deliver dashboards and 3+ sized recommendations.

Summary: US-01: To see one headline on-time delivery % with a monthly trend on page 1
Description:
As a COO, I want to see one headline on-time delivery % with a monthly trend on page 1, so that I can tell at a glance whether we are getting better.

Requirement: FR-04

Acceptance criteria:
* Given the Executive page is open, when I look at the top of the page, then I see the on-time % for delivered orders and a monthly trend line.
* Given I select a date range with the slicer, when the page refreshes, then the on-time % and trend reflect only that range and match SQL within 1%.

Summary: Build analysis: SQL-05 on-time rate by month (CASE late/on-time)
Build visual: PBI Executive: On-time % card + monthly trend
Write and run UAT test TC-04
US-02: A one-page summary of on-time rate, review score, repeat rate and the top 3 actions
Description:
As a COO, I want a one-page summary of on-time rate, review score, repeat rate and the top 3 actions, so that I can sign off next year's logistics budget.

Requirement: FR-16

Acceptance criteria:
* Given the analysis is complete, when I open the recommendations memo, then I see 3+ actions, each with evidence, the KPI it moves and a sized impact.

Summary: Build analysis: All queries
Build visual: Recommendations memo; final deck
Write and run UAT test TC-16

Acceptance criteria:
